subject: Evaluation MAP & licensing for Private VPC pilot
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novagrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novagrid.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Eval kickoff: Private VPC pilot / MAP & initial ask

Marcus —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. NovaGrid is interested in a short Private VPC pilot to validate latency and telemetry for our internal search use case. Before we kick off I need a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out milestones and commercial triggers. Key items for us:

- Clear milestone schedule (POC -> pilot -> production) with target dates
- Pricing + any platform fee for Private (we may consider on-prem later)
- Commit levels that qualify for discounts/ramp credits
- Security evidence (SOC2 scope, encryption, audit logs)

Can you send a MAP and a straw commercial offer that ties pricing/discounts to milestone completion? We have quarterly procurement reviews starting 11/15, so would need a paper trail and a PO by mid-November to make the quarter.

Thanks,
Susan Park
VP Product, NovaGrid

[External to Redwood Inference]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@novagrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: Private VPC pilot / MAP & initial ask

Hi Susan —

Great to hear. I've attached a working MAP (MAP_NovaGrid_v4.xlsx) and a short commercial summary. High level proposal below so procurement has something to review quickly:

MAP highlights (milestones & dates)
- M1 (POC kickoff): 2026-10-01 — test connectivity, small eval model, perf baseline
- M2 (Pilot launch): 2026-10-22 — private VPC, full eval corpus, telemetry onboarding
- M3 (Ramp to prod): 2026-11-15 — commit to reserved capacity or go-live plan (PO/Invoice)

Commercial straw (Private VPC / on-prem path)
- Term: 12 months from go-live (standard)
- Commit band A: 100k token-equivalent/month (12m) => 18% platform fee waiver + 12% usage discount after M3
- Commit band B: 250k token-equivalent/month (12m) => platform fee waived + 20% usage discount after M3
- If NovaGrid prefers a lower initial commit (pilot), we can stage commits in a staircase (M2 -> M3) with pro rata discounts tied to actual usage ramp.
- Platform fee (Private VPC): $6,000/month by default (covers private control plane, telemetry retention). Waived in full for Band B; 50% rebate available if Band A achieved within 90 days of M3.

Security & procurement
- SOC2 summary attached (SOC2-summary.pdf). Full report available under NDA.
- Standard redlines captured in draft-license-redlines.docx; Karthik will follow up on any legal points.

Next steps
1) Review MAP + commercial straw and propose any alternate dates/commit bands
2) Agree on evaluation acceptance criteria (we include a short quality checklist in the MAP)
3) If acceptable, we can convert the MAP to a mutual action plan with sign-off and a DocuSign link for the SOW/Order Form.

I'll hold a half-hour alignment call next week if that helps — Monica (CS) will drive onboarding details.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_NovaGrid_v4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 145KB)]
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]
[Attachment: draft-license-redlines.docx (docx, 68KB)]
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novagrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novagrid.com>, NovaGrid Procurement <procurement@novagrid.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: Private VPC pilot / MAP & initial ask

Marcus —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAP. A few clarifications and asks from our side after an internal read:

- M2 -> M3 timing: We can hit M2 (pilot) on 10/22, but production ramp to M3 likely will be slower — target 11/30 rather than 11/15. Procurement window is tight; if we can get a signed SOW/Order Form with a PO by 11/30 we can prioritize the spend into Q4.
- Commit bands: Band B looks attractive but is aggressive for us up front. Can you propose a staircase commit where Band A is guaranteed in months 1-3 post-M3, then step to higher tiers by month 6 with defined success triggers (latency < 100ms p95, model quality pass rate > 92% on eval set)?
- Platform fee: $6k/mo is higher than we expected. If we commit to a 12-month reserved capacity at Band A, can you reduce the platform fee to $3k/mo (or provide a credit schedule tied to ramp)?
- SOC2: the summary looks good. Procurement will request the full report under NDA — can we get that this week?

If we can get a revised MAP that shows the staircase commit and an explicit credit schedule for platform fee tied to commits, we can route to procurement next week.

Thanks,
Susan
VP Product, NovaGrid
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Susan Park <susan.park@novagrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, NovaGrid Procurement <procurement@novagrid.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:57:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: Private VPC pilot / MAP & initial ask

Susan / Tom / Procurement —

Thanks for the feedback. Per your asks we updated the MAP and commercial terms (attached). Summary of changes:

1) Staircase commit proposal
- Phase A (M3 to M3+3 months): Band A baseline (100k token-eq/month). If usage >= 100k in months 1-3 post-M3, we confirm Band A pricing and apply 18% platform fee rebate across next invoice cycle.
- Phase B (M3+3 to M3+6): If performance triggers met (latency & quality) and usage >= 200k token-eq/month for 30 consecutive days, we step to Band B pricing and fully waive platform fee starting month of attainment.

2) Platform fee credit schedule
- If Band A achieved within 90 days post-M3: 50% platform fee rebate for next 3 billing cycles
- If Band B achieved within 180 days post-M3: full platform fee waiver retroactive to M3
- If NovaGrid signs a 12-month commitment at M3 with PO: provide an upfront one-time credit equal to one month platform fee ($6,000) applied to first invoice (or $3,000 if you prefer a lower immediate credit and larger rebate schedule).

3) Timing
- We updated MAP timeline to show M3 target 2026-11-30 to align with your procurement window.

4) Docs
- Full SOC2 report available under NDA — Karthik can share the secure link once we have an executed NDA.
- Redlines: we've accepted standard customer breach definitions but flagged two clauses (data egress SLAs and indemnity caps) for quick legal review. Karthik will propose language this week.

Attachments: updated MAP spreadsheet and a concise one-page commercial summary. If procurement wants a single consolidated SOW + order form, we can build a package for signature.

Let us know if the credit schedule above is acceptable or which of the options you prefer (larger up-front credit vs. staged rebate). If you confirm, I'll ask our operations team to prepare the Order Form and a DocuSign link.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_NovaGrid_v4.xlsx (updated, spreadsheet, 158KB)]
[Attachment: commercial-summary-onepager.pdf (pdf, 45KB)]
From: Susan Park <susan.park@novagrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@novagrid.com>, NovaGrid Procurement <procurement@novagrid.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff: Private VPC pilot / MAP & initial ask

Marcus / Team —

Appreciate the revisions. Procurement reviewed and we can live with the staircase approach and the credit schedule you outlined. A few final items before we issue the PO:

- Please confirm the DocuSign Order Form will include the Band A baseline and the credit schedule clauses verbatim (we'll attach the PO referencing the signed order form).
- Karthik: please send the SOC2 full report link under NDA and confirm the proposed language for data egress SLAs. Procurement will surface any last-minute redlines but hopes to avoid material changes.
- Can you confirm invoicing cadence (monthly in arrears) and that platform fee credits will be applied to the next invoice after milestone attainment?

If you can get the Order Form and the SOC2 link to us by 11/12 we will route for signature and target issuing the PO on 11/30. Once the PO is in, we can lock M3 as 11/30 and start onboarding.

Thanks — we are excited to get this moving.

Susan Park
VP Product, NovaGrid
[Signed: informal acknowledgement — PO issuance dependent on final order form]
